data.rationale: The proposal follows the true flow (open event, select tickets, book/choose option, Reserve Now) in the right order with city, event and ticket count as parameters. It omits the date parameter, is vague on city selection and on how to reach Special Events, and adds a time_slot parameter that wasn't varied, so an automation would need to guess some details.
